parameters.name: CenRegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID.

You can call the [DescribeChildInstanceRegions](~~132080~~) operation to obtain the region ID.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page during paging. Default value: **10**. Valid values: **1** to **500**.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of the route entry. Valid values:

- **Active** (default): active.

- **Candidate**: backup.

- **Rejected**: rejected.

- **Prohibited**: prohibited.

- **All**: queries route entries in all states in the current region.
